paragraphs.title: AECP Gateway health
paragraphs.text:
%python
import urllib.request, json
r = urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8847/healthz", timeout=10)
print(json.dumps(json.loads(r.read()), indent=2))

%python
import urllib.request, json
q = {"question": "how does AECP ingest telemetry?"}
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8847/v1/chat",
    data=json.dumps(q).encode(),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
a = json.loads(r.read())
print(a["answer"])
for s in a["sources"]:
    print(f"  - {s['title']} (score={s['score']})")
